description: Returns the cap on repaying excess advance premium tax credit (APTC) at tax time. For tax year 2025: Form 8962 Table 5 ($375/$750 below 200% FPL, $975/$1,950 at 200-300%, $1,625/$3,250 at 300-400%, single/other filing status; no cap at 400% or more). For tax year 2026 and later there is NO cap: the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (P.L. 119-21 sec. 71305) repealed it, so the full excess is repaid. Many models trained before 2026 still quote the old caps.

excess_aptc.description: Advance payments minus the credit you are allowed (Form 8962 line 27). Optional.

filing_status.description: Filing status. Table 5 has a single column and an any-other-status column.

household_income.description: Household income in dollars for the coverage year: modified AGI of you, your spouse and dependents who must file.

household_size.description: Tax family size: you, your spouse if filing jointly, and every dependent you claim.

state.description: State of residence: two-letter code or name (AK and HI have their own poverty lines; all other states and DC share one).

name: get_aptc_repayment_cap
title: Excess advance premium tax credit repayment cap
